why: MISSING for Q53: no published or in-hand HCN/HCO+ 4-3 ratio at N/S finer than our 4.1x2.7" (620 pc) Xb47 data, while Izumi+2016 AGN/SB groups are at 35-470 pc. HCN 4-3 at 0.70" (2018.1.00493.S, spw29, 349.9-351.8 GHz covers the line) and HCO+ 4-3 at 0.30" (2018.1.00223.S X858 spw27, 352.15-354.03 GHz) allow a matched 0.7-1" (130-190 pc) 4-3 ratio at N and S to test the extrapolation; 1.64 GB total.
